job.request_text: Design a PP guide for a 5.2 N load, 1.1 mm stroke, 85 x 55 mm package, drift under 0.032 mm, and stress under 26 MPa.

hypothesis.diagnosis: Baseline corner failed absolute drift gate at 0.0354mm over 0.032mm limit while stroke and stress passed comfortably.
hypothesis.correction: Further stiffen outer flexures to reduce parasitic drift and increase margin while preserving stroke feasibility.
hypothesis.justification: Previous +0.1 inner/+0.1 outer reduced drift 0.0354 to 0.0294mm and kept stroke 1.74mm; extra outer thickness should further cut drift with ample stroke margin.
hypothesis.falsification_condition: If measured drift fails to decrease versus 0.0294mm or stroke/stress gates fail, the stiffening hypothesis is falsified.
